versions.changelog:
- Initial release of ted-english-learning skill.
- Converts TED talk PDFs into structured bilingual notes and Canvas mind maps.
- Produces side-by-side Chinese-English texts, vocabulary lists, content summaries, sentence analysis, and exam-style reading questions.
- Strict file naming and output path rules: output uses original PDF filename, stored in fixed directories.
- Canvas export follows strict JSON formatting for compatibility with Obsidian.
- Command can process both PDF files and pasted English text.
